name: HODIE Practice Taxonomy v2
purpose: Separate session intent, communicative skills, language resources and micro-activity mechanics so every practice category has a distinct pedagogical function.

mixed.goal: Build a varied practice session around the current Can-Do and recent evidence.
mustNot: repeat the same activity type by default

review.goal: Recover, reinforce or retain capacities identified from evidence.
mustNot: use a fixed generic exercise list
advance a Can-Do solely because a review activity was completed

communicativeSkills.communication: Interact, respond, clarify and repair meaning.

languageResources.grammar: Form and structure used to communicate meaning.
languageResources.vocabulary: Words and expressions needed to understand and communicate.

rules: Can-Do is the unit of capability.
Micro-activity is the unit of practice.
Integrated demonstration is the unit of authoritative evidence.
Grammar and vocabulary support communication; they are not the final learning goal.
Confidence is diagnostic and must not by itself invalidate adequate performance evidence.
